acceptance: Changing a file under `.github/workflows/` makes `make pr-preflight` run the tests that read that workflow, not only the `oracle-` scenario tests.
`tests/unit/scripts/test_preflight_targets.py` covers a change to a non-oracle workflow selecting its tests.
description: `_project/scripts/preflight_targets.py` maps a changed non-Python path to tests only through the `SOURCE_GUARD_TESTS` prefixes, and the only workflow prefix there is `.github/workflows/oracle-`. Changing any other workflow selects nothing, although tests read those files: under `tests/unit/workflows` and `tests/system`, 20 test files mention `ci.yml`, 9 `nightly-v2.yml`, 6 `trunk.yml` and 4 `trunk-coverage.yml`. On #3725, a commit that edited `ci.yml` and `nightly-v2.yml` passed preflight with only the 7 tests mapped from the branch's Python changes. The 1,033 workflow and CI-parity tests ran only because they were started by hand, so a broken workflow test would have surfaced one CI round later.
